bo: de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyis mthar gyis spyod pa yod pa yin te

bo: byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing
